root_cause: The product migration updated the provider schema and declaration instruction, but one Skill unit oracle still treats the retired depends_on field and prompt wording as required live behavior.
causal_chain: The live provider schema removes goal.properties.depends_on and requires input_bindings.
The dialogue declaration instruction forbids depends_on and assigns deterministic compilation to Runtime.
The stale Skill oracle directly indexes the removed property and searches for the retired prompt sentence.
The Skill control-plane profile therefore fails before the Playwright quality job can start.
rejected_hypotheses: Restoring depends_on to the provider schema is forbidden because it recreates a second live graph writer.
Deleting the Skill test is forbidden because it would remove historical multi-goal counterexamples.
Skipping skill-control-plane is forbidden because it is a required CI predecessor.
